clips.title: The story
paras: Ridgepoint Tower is a fortified guard post watching the eastern frontier of Elwynn Forest. Manned by the Stormwind Guard, it serves as an early warning bulwark against hostile incursions threatening the heart of the kingdom. Its guards keep vigil over the perilous corridors leading to neighboring wilderness.

Standing sentinel on the high ground of eastern Elwynn Forest, Ridgepoint Tower marks the final bastion of direct Stormwind authority before the untamed wilds take over. The garrison stationed here keeps a constant watch over the surrounding valleys and roads. With tensions mounting across the continent, this stone watchtower ensures that encroaching threats are spotted and checked before they can endanger the farms and settlements closer to Northshire and Goldshire.
